statements.status_notes: GHSA-x99g-8v8j-25j2: digestToPath() in the tensor transfer path performs no validation of the digest string before using it in a filesystem path join, and is reached from an untrusted remote manifest during a model pull. No upstream fix is available yet; tracking ollama/ollama#17178 and the associated fix PR #17214.

GHSA-x9hg-5q6g-q3jr: cross-domain authorization token exposure in getAuthorizationToken, affects ollama up to and including 0.9.6. Fixed upstream via ollama PR #10750. This image ships ollama 0.34.2, well past the fixed version.
GHSA-89qx-m49c-8crf: out-of-bounds read in the GGUF parser, affects ollama up to and including 0.3.14. This image ships ollama 0.34.2, well past the fixed version.
GHSA-2xf2-gjm6-g2c6: divide-by-zero via a crafted GGUF block_count field, affects only ollama 0.3.3. This image ships ollama 0.34.2.
GHSA-p2wh-w96x-w232: null pointer dereference via a crafted GGUF file, affects ollama up to and including 0.3.14. This image ships ollama 0.34.2, well past the fixed version.
GHSA-fccc-8m69-8r78: unbounded memory allocation via a crafted GGUF file, affects ollama up to and including 0.3.14. This image ships ollama 0.34.2, well past the fixed version.
GHSA-9gcr-28rp-cc24: divide-by-zero in GGUF padding calculation, affects ollama up to and including 0.3.14. This image ships ollama 0.34.2, well past the fixed version.
GHSA-f6mr-38g8-39rg: authentication bypass on API endpoints, affects ollama up to and including 0.13.5. Fixed upstream in 0.13.6. This image ships ollama 0.34.2, well past the fixed version.
